researcher_notes: Biographical research for the 8 leading 2026 California gubernatorial primary candidates. Tier 1 sources (campaign sites, Ballotpedia, Wikipedia, FEC/state filings) used preferentially; Tier 2 sources (CalMatters, CNN, NBC, KQED, SF Chronicle/Examiner) used for triangulation and recent campaign-cycle facts (fundraising, endorsements, polling). Date-of-birth, education, and elected-office history are confirmed across at least two sources for every candidate. Net worth was harder to nail down for non-billionaires: where official tax-return disclosures (CalMatters, March 2026) exist, we use 2024-2025 income as a proxy and explain in notes that a true net-worth figure is not publicly disclosed. Race/ethnicity, religion, and sexuality recorded only where the candidate has self-identified publicly or is consistently described by mainstream secondary sources; otherwise set to 'not publicly stated'. The 'personal_attributes' scores are research-informed best-fit categorizations grounded in the cited sources and the project's scoring rubric (e.g. electability anchored to SurveyUSA May 1, 2026 numbers).

bio.race_ethnicity: White; British-American of Hungarian descent (parents emigrated from Hungary during the 1956 revolution); self-identifies as immigrant son. Naturalized U.S. citizen May 11, 2021.
bio.net_worth_note: No public net-worth estimate; CalMatters (March 2026) reports $7.5M joint 2024 income with wife Rachel Whetstone (Netflix CCO) — $250K from Fox News, $6.7M from wife's Netflix role, $360K from global investments, $25K from three London rental properties. Independent estimates range $3-10M (uncited tabloids).
bio.self_funded_note: Not a major self-funder; raised >$6.6M from donors as of April 2026 per Wikipedia/Ballotpedia. Wealthy by income but not self-funding at Steyer scale.
bio.education: BA Philosophy, Politics and Economics — New College, Oxford (1991)

sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Steve_Hilton — DOB, birthplace, education, career history, naturalization date, marriage
candidates.notes: Hilton resides in Atherton/Silicon Valley; classified as bay_area for residence. No public net worth estimate from a credible source — left null. Religion not publicly discussed; left 'not publicly stated'. Electability score of 5 reflects SurveyUSA May 1, 2026 lead at 20%.

bio.birthplace: Manhattan, New York City, New York
bio.race_ethnicity: White; Jewish father (Roy Henry Steyer, Nuremberg prosecutor) and Episcopalian mother. Steyer identifies as Episcopalian Christian (converted/embraced in his late 30s).
bio.net_worth_note: Forbes April 2026 estimate: $2.4 billion. Founded Farallon Capital (1986), left 2012. Signed The Giving Pledge.
bio.self_funded_note: As of late April 2026, ~$122.5M of $122.7M raised was self-funded (~99.9%). Total campaign spend on track to exceed $147M, approaching Meg Whitman's 2010 state record (~$144M self-funded of $176M).
bio.education: MBA — Stanford Graduate School of Business (1983). BA in economics and political science (summa cum laude) — Yale University (1979).

sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tom_Steyer — DOB, education, career, family, net worth
candidates.notes: Self-identifies as Episcopalian Christian; some sources note Jewish paternal heritage. Both demographic tags applied. Resides in San Francisco. Electability 5 anchored on 18% SurveyUSA (May 1), strong fundraising, and labor/environmental endorsements.

bio.race_ethnicity: White; American of Italian descent (per Wikipedia)
bio.net_worth_note: No public net-worth estimate. CalMatters (March 2026): $590K joint 2025 income with spouse; $348K sheriff base salary (after 27% raise in 2024).
bio.self_funded_note: Not a self-funder; relies on Republican donor base and grassroots. CalMatters reports campaign cash on hand far below Hilton.
bio.education: BS — Columbia Southern University. Attended College of Eastern Utah and University of Utah.

sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chad_Bianco — DOB, birthplace, education, career, family, religion (Sandals Church), Oath Keepers 2014 membership
https://calmatters.org/politics/2026/04/california-gop-convention-governor/ — CRP convention results (Bianco 49%, Hilton 44%, neither hit 60% endorsement threshold)
candidates.notes: Years in elected office = 7 (sworn in Jan 7, 2019). Integrity score 2 reflects $100M federal lawsuit (later dismissed) over Vem Miller arrest, ballot-seizure controversy, and 2014 one-year Oath Keepers membership — these are major controversies though no convictions. Riverside County classified as Inland Empire (oc_ie). Trump endorsed Hilton instead, but California Republican Assembly endorsed Bianco.
